# Overview

Body text goes here. Paragraphs, lists, and links are styled
automatically — just write normally.

**Key point** worth emphasizing appears in FC blue automatically.

## A Section

Use `#` for top-level sections (blue rule underneath) and `##`
for sections within them (blue left bar).

- First topic
- Second topic
- Third topic

### A Sub-point

Use `###` for a smaller, italicized sub-heading, styled in FC sky
blue.

# Callout Boxes

::: {.blue-box}
Use `.blue-box` for a primary emphasis callout — solid FC blue
background, white text.
:::

::: {.yellow-box}
Use `.yellow-box` for a highlight or warning-style callout.
:::

::: {.gray-box}
Use `.gray-box` for a lower-emphasis supporting note — light
background, blue left border.
:::

# A Table

| Enrollment       | 1,204     | 1,331     |
| Retention Rate   | 78%       | 81%       |
| Success Rate     | 71%       | 74%       |

# A Chart

PDFs need static charts — use ggplot2 with `theme_fc()` (set as
the default by `use_fc_theme()` in setup.R) rather than plotly.

```{r}
#| label: fig-example
#| fig-cap: "Highway mileage by engine displacement."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 3.5

ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = drv)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_fc() +
  labs(
    x = "Engine displacement (L)",
    y = "Highway MPG",
    color = "Drive"
  )
```

# A Quote

> Use blockquotes for pulled quotes, testimonials, or emphasis text
> that should stand apart from the body copy.
